description: DISPLAY of numeric function results in GnuCOBOL's forms: ABS / MAX / MIN in the picture of their argument (DISPLAY, COMP-3, BINARY, SIGN SEPARATE items and literals), SUM / NUMVAL / NUMVAL-C / MOD / REM / INTEGER in the field sized from the value (9 or 20 digits, trailing zeros dropped, high digits cut); hexadecimal and Z literals
